blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands.
Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware.
Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss.
These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compression the errors compound with depth and performance collapses.
We introduce Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which instead learns the subspaces to discard end-to-end.
Each linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is assigned an orthogonal projector.
All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective—the KL divergence to the dense model’s output distribution or the model’s original training loss—while the pretrained weights remain frozen.
Projectors are initialized from a whitened SVD truncation, and ranks are allocated by the output KL each projector induces per parameter saved.
After training, the projectors merge into standard low-rank factors, with each tied group sharing one factor.
In attention, this also lets the model cache one narrow latent in place of full keys and values.
Across LLMs (OPT-125M/1.3B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B) and ViT-B/16, LSP outperforms baselines, and its advantage widens as compression increases.
At − 70 % -70\% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2 % 42.2\% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 13.3 and 36.0 % 36.0\% for the strongest baseline.
The factorized model decodes up to 1.6 × 1.6\times faster than the dense model at small batch sizes, and aching the shared latent shrinks the combined memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5 × 13.5\times at a 128k-token context, versus at most 6.5 × 6.5\times for untied baseline factorizations.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) have become the dominant architecture in deep learning, owing to their flexibility, scalability, and strong performance across tasks and modalities.
Their uniform design enables rapid development and stable scaling; however, it also leaves trained models highly redundant.
Large models exhibit low intrinsic dimensionality ( Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ; Kuzborskij and Abbasi Yadkori, 2025 ) , with their capabilities concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace of their parameters.
Compression exploits this redundancy to reduce memory and compute while preserving the model’s behavior.
blocks.zh:
变形器(Vaswani等,2017年)因其灵活性,可伸缩性,以及跨任务和方式的强效而成为了深度学习中的主导架构.
它们的统一设计能够迅速发展和稳定地扩大规模;但是,它也使训练有素的模型非常多余。
大型模型的内在维度较低(Aghajanyan等,2021;Kuzborskij和Abbasi Yadkori,2025),其能力集中于其参数的低维子空间.
压缩利用这种冗余来减少内存并计算,同时保留模型的行为.

blocks.en:
Low-rank compression is a natural way to realize these savings, replacing each weight matrix with the product of two smaller factors.
Yet this redundancy is not directly visible in the weights’ spectra.
The singular values of pretrained Transformer weights decay slowly, so naive truncated SVD severely degrades performance ( Hsu et al., 2022 ) .
Practical low-rank compression instead builds on an empirical observation: the activations flowing between layers lie in low-dimensional subspaces ( Yu and Wu, 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Garg et al., 2024 ; Skean et al., 2025 ) .
Existing methods read the useful subspace off activation statistics, either from the energy of the layer input, as in ASVD ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , SliceGPT ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) , and MoDeGPT ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , or from the reconstruction error of the layer output, as in SVD-LLM ( Wang et al., 2025d ) and Swift-SVD ( Qi et al., 2026 ) .
Either criterion captures the layer, not the network: a low-energy direction is discarded whether or not the network’s output depends on it ( Figure 1 ), and a layer-wise optimum says nothing about how its residual error propagates downstream.
Loss-aware methods bring the network in through a local surrogate—Fisher-weighted reconstruction in FW-SVD ( Hsu et al., 2022 ) or a quadratic curvature model in LLM-Surgeon ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ) —but such surrogates hold only for small perturbations of the dense weights, whereas aggressive compression moves far from them.
Dobi-SVD ( Wang et al., 2025b ) optimizes the loss directly, but learns only the per-matrix truncation rank.
The loss thus shapes local approximations, sets ranks, or repairs the weights after truncation; in none of these methods does the network loss itself choose which directions are removed.
What compression has to identify, then, is the network’s functional subspace : the directions whose retention preserves its behavior on the data of interest.
Our starting observation is that choosing a subspace amounts to choosing an orthogonal projector: applying a rank- r r projector to a weight matrix leaves it with rank at most r r , so it factors into two thin matrices.
The search for the functional subspace can thus be cast as a search over projectors.
This raises our central question: can we obtain better compressed models by learning which subspace to remove, optimizing the projectors end-to-end against the frozen network’s output?
blocks.zh:
低等压缩是实现这些节约的自然方法,用两个较小因素的产物来取代每个重量矩阵.
然而,这种冗余在权重的光谱中没有直接可见。
预先被训练的变形器重量的单数慢慢地衰变,如此天真地被截断的SVD会严重地降低性能(Hsu等,2022.).
相反,实用的低级压缩是基于经验观察:层相间的活化作用存在于低维子空间(Yu和Wu,2023;Yuan等,2024;Garg等,2024;Skean等,2025)。
现有方法读取了有用的子空间脱离激活统计,或者来自地层输入的能量,如ASVD(Yuan等,2024年),SliceGPT (Ashkboos等,2024年),和MoDeGPT (Lin等,2025年),或由地层输出重建出错而来,如SVD-LLM (Wang等,2025d)和Swift-SVD (Qi等,2026年).
无论哪一种标准能捕捉到地层,而不是网络:不管网络的输出是否取决于地层(图1),低能取向都会被丢弃,而从地层上看,其残留错误如何在下游传播却没有任何意义。
认识损失的方法通过本地代孕将网络带入... FW-SVD(Hsu等,2022年)或LLM-外科(van der Ouderaa等,2024年)的四曲面模型中渔夫加权重建——但这种代孕只能用于密集重量的小扰动,而积极的压缩则远离它们.
Dobi-SVD (Wang et al., 2025b) 直接优化了损失,但只学习了per-matrix分流分级.
因此,损失会塑造局部近似,设置分级,或修补断接后重量;在这些方法中,没有一种是网络损失本身选择去掉哪个方向.
因此,压缩必须确定的是网络的功能子空间:保留其行为在相关数据上保持方向。
我们的开始观察是,选择一个子空间等于选择正向投影仪:将一个正向投影仪应用到一个重量矩阵中,使得它处于最高正向的正向位置,因此它会将它计入两个细的矩阵。
因此,对功能子空间的搜索可以作为对投影器的搜索来进行.
这提出了我们的中心问题:我们是否可以通过学习哪个子空间去除,优化投影器的端到端与被冻结的网络输出来获得更好的压缩模型?

blocks.en:
We propose Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which does exactly this: every projector is learned against a global objective, by default the KL divergence to the dense model’s output distribution, or alternatively the model’s original training objective, a variant we denote LSP T .
Our contributions are: (1) Learned subspace projections. Layers that read the same activations (Q/K/V, gate/up) form a tied group and share one projector; we optimize all projectors jointly across the network with the pretrained weights frozen. An activation-space parameterization with fused QR orthonormalization keeps this tractable at billion-parameter scale. (2) Whitened initialization and measured-KL allocation. Each projector is initialized from a whitened truncation, recast as an orthogonal projector and extended to tied groups.
To decide how many directions each layer or tied group removes, we apply each projector in isolation, measure the KL divergence it induces on the model output, and allocate the budget by KL cost per saved parameter.
The model at initialization, which we call NoLSP, serves as a control that isolates the effect of learning. (3) Efficient low-rank inference. After training, the projectors merge into plain low-rank factors, so the deployed model contains no LSP-specific operations.
At the same compression ratio it requires the same FLOPs per token as other factorizations, yet the input factor shared by each tied group speeds up small-batch decoding and, in a latent-cache deployment, stores one narrow latent per group where untied factorizations store two (one each for keys and values), shrinking the KV cache. Because LSP applies to any linear layer, the same recipe transfers across Transformer models without architecture-specific surgery.
LSP outperforms pruning and SVD baselines by a margin that grows with the compression ratio, and on ViT it degrades least among the compared methods when calibration and evaluation distributions differ.

我们提议学习的子空间预测(LSP ) , 这个预测就是这样做的:每个投影仪都是按照全球目标学习的, 默认的是KL与密集模型的输出分布的相差, 或者说模型的原始训练目标, 我们表示LSP T的变体。
我们的贡献是: (1) 获得的子空间预测。 读取同一种活化(Q/K/V,闸口/上)的层组成了捆绑的组并共用一个投影仪;我们用被预先训练的重量被冻结,在网络上联合优化所有投影仪. 装有引信的QR正正态化的活化-空间参数化使这种可牵引性保持在十亿参数尺度. (2) 白化初始化和计量的KL分配。 每个投影仪从白调分出后被初始化,被重塑为正交投影仪并被扩展为被捆绑的组.
为了决定每一层或捆绑组去除多少个方向,我们孤立地应用每个投影仪,在模型输出上测量它所诱导的KL相差,并按每个被保存参数的KL成本分配预算.
初始化时的模型,我们称之为"NoLSP",起到隔离学习效果的控制作用. (3)高效低级推论. 经过训练后,投影仪合并为平地低等因子,因此所部署的型号没有包含LSP特有的操作.
在相同的压缩比下,它要求每个给定的FLOP与其他分量化相同,然而每个被绑定的组共用的输入因子会加速小批解码,并在潜移-缓存部署中,存储每个组一个狭长的潜伏,其中被绑定的分量化存储两个(密钥和值各一个),收缩了KV缓存. 因为LSP适用于任何线性地层,所以同样的食谱在变形器模型之间进行转移,而不进行建筑特定外科手术.
LSP比运行和 SVD 基线的比值要高,而压缩比会随着压缩率的增长而增长,在VIT上,在校正和评价分布不同时,在比较方法中,它的降解程度最小.

blocks.en: 2 Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP)
blocks.zh: 2 可学习的子空间预测(LSP)

blocks.en: LSP compresses a pretrained network into its functional subspace: each targeted linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is composed with a learned orthogonal projector, and all projectors are optimized end-to-end against the model output with the pretrained weights frozen. Figure 2 summarizes the pipeline, Section 2.1 gives the formulation, Section 2.2 the whitened initialization and measured-KL allocation, and Section 2.3 the training procedure and the merge into low-rank factors.

blocks.en: 2.2 Whitened Initialization and Measured-KL Allocation
blocks.zh: 2.2 白化初始化和计量-KL分配

blocks.en:
Before training, each compressed unit—a tied group or an individual layer—needs a subspace to start from and a number of directions to remove.
The subspace comes from an ordered whitened basis, so that removing k k directions amounts to dropping its trailing k k vectors; the number comes from the KL divergence each candidate truncation induces on the model output, allocated under the global parameter budget.
The basis is thus spectral, the allocation loss-aware.

Choice of objective. Distillation is the default: it targets the dense model’s full output distribution rather than a single target, and for classifiers it needs no labels, so any unlabeled pool can serve for calibration ( Section 3.2 ).
The task loss (LSP T ) instead fits the calibration data directly, so it can specialize the model when the calibration data matches the deployment task; in our experiments, LSP T reaches its best validation score in fewer epochs on average ( Appendix F ).

Setup. For language models we compress OPT-125M/1.3B ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , Qwen3-4B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Llama-2-7B ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) . We report WikiText-2 ( Merity et al., 2016 ) test perplexity, calibrating as SliceGPT does on 1024 sequences of 2048 tokens from the training split, and zero-shot accuracy on six benchmarks with the calibration data given in Section 3.1 .
Early stopping and every tuned setting are selected on held-out validation splits.
On Qwen3-4B, whose grouped-query K and V are a quarter of Q’s width, K and V share an output-side projector and Q is projected alone; every other model ties Q/K/V on the input side ( Appendix B ).
For vision we compress a ViT-B/16 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) fine-tuned on CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) and report source accuracy and linear-probe transfer.
A compression ratio is the fraction of the parameters of the linear layers (no embeddings, no head) that is removed.
All baselines run from their official code with the same calibration data and precision as LSP; SVD baselines are evaluated in factorized form, with tunable settings swept around the official optima ( Appendix B ).

Baselines. Activation- and reconstruction-based baselines , constructed from activation statistics or reconstruction criteria: SliceGPT ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) , ASVD ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , SVD-LLM (W) ( Wang et al., 2025d ) , whose whitening minimizes the layer-wise reconstruction error, and Swift-SVD ( Qi et al., 2026 ) , which reaches the same per-layer optimum from the output covariance and adds a per-matrix rank allocation. Loss-aware baselines use gradients of the loss: LLM-Surgeon ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ) , through a Kronecker-factored curvature model, and Dobi-SVD ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , which learns only the per-matrix truncation rank within a closed-form basis, run without its quantization step so that parameter counts match.
SVD-LLM is reported also with its LoRA recovery fine-tuning.
On vision we compare with SliceGPT, SVD-LLM (W), FLAR-SVD ( Thoma et al., 2025 ) , and PELA ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . The last two are proposed on vision models, with PELA retraining all parameters by distilling every block’s output features from the dense model.
NoLSP is the non-trained version of LSP, controlling for the learning stage at fixed initialization, ranks and ties.

blocks.en:
Perplexity. Table 1 reports WikiText-2 test perplexity at − 30 / 50 / 70 % -30/50/70\% compression.
One of the two LSP variants has the lowest perplexity in all 12 model–ratio settings, and the margin grows with the ratio.
At − 70 % -70\% the training-free SVD methods deteriorate sharply, and so does NoLSP, the untrained initialization at the same ranks: learning the directions is what keeps the compressed models usable.
No loss-aware baseline closes the gap at − 70 % -70\% , including LoRA-recovered SVD-LLM, the strongest baseline on the three larger models.
The task loss (LSP T ) leads mostly on the smaller models and at lower ratios, where it can fall below dense test perplexity (both OPT models at − 30 % -30\% ).
Since the calibration text is the WikiText-2 training split, this reflects specialization to the evaluation domain ( Section 2.3 ); LoRA-recovered SVD-LLM shows the same effect on OPT-1.3B. Distillation (LSP) leads instead on the larger models and at higher ratios.

疑惑相会. 表1汇报了WikiText-2测试的迷惑度为-30 / 50 / 70%-30/50/70\%压缩.

由于校正文本是WikiText-2训练分出,这反映了专业化到评价领域(第2.3节);LORA所回收的SVD-LLM对OPL-1.3B也显示出同样的效果. 蒸发导致较大的模型和较高的比率。

blocks.en:
Zero-shot accuracy. Optimizing compression on a target objective raises a natural concern: does the compressed model retain general capabilities, or is the retained capacity overfit to the calibration objective? Table 2 follows two protocols from the literature on six commonsense, science and math benchmarks, OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) , ARC-easy ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2019 ) , HellaSwag ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) , PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) and MathQA ( Amini et al., 2019 ) : Llama-2-7B at − 30 / 50 / 70 % -30/50/70\% with Alpaca calibration ( Taori et al., 2023 ) , following Wang et al. (2025d) , and Qwen3-4B at − 20 / 40 / 60 % -20/40/60\% with C4 calibration ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) , following Qi et al. (2026) .
We compare with the low-rank baselines, the closest to LSP ( Appendix B ).
Both LSP variants lead the strongest training-free baseline in mean accuracy at every ratio, by 6.7 6.7 – 10.5 10.5 points on Llama-2-7B and 6.2 6.2 – 10.8 10.8 on Qwen3-4B.
The two objectives are within two points of each other, with distillation ahead or tied in every setting.

零射精度. 对目标目标的优化压缩引起了自然的担忧:被压缩的模型是否保留了一般能力,还是保留的能力与校正目标过于相适应? 表2遵循了文献中关于六种常识,科学和数学基准的两项协议,OpenBookQA(Mihaylov等,2018年),ARC-easy(Clark等,2018年),WinoGrande (Sakaguchi等人,2019年),HellaSwag (Zellers等人,2019年),PIQA (Bisk等人,2020年)和MathQA (Amini等人,2019年) :Llama-2-7B at − 30 / 50 / 70%-30/50/70\% 与阿尔帕卡校正(Taori等人,2023年),如下: Wang 等 (2025d), 和 Qwen3-4B 以 − 20 / 40 / 60% - 20/40/60 + * 与 C4 校正 (Raffel等人,2020年),随后 齐等 (2026).

blocks.en: 3.2 Vision Transformers
blocks.zh: 3.2 愿景变换器

blocks.en:
Vision models let us control the calibration data cleanly: we can change the composition of the calibration set at a fixed size, and evaluate the compressed network both on its source task and, through linear-probes, on unseen datasets.
We use this to ask how much each method depends on seeing the evaluation distribution at compression time.
We build two calibration pools of the same size: a single pool of 47k CIFAR-100 training images, in-domain with the model and its evaluation task, and a diverse pool that keeps 10k of them and adds Food-101 ( Bossard et al., 2014 ) , CIFAR-10 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) , EuroSAT ( Helber et al., 2018 ) , STL-10 ( Coates et al., 2011 ) and DTD ( Cimpoi et al., 2014 ) , capped at 10k images each.
The added datasets share no label space with CIFAR-100, so Table 3 compares only label-free methods: the training-free baselines; PELA, whose feature distillation needs no labels; and LSP, whose distillation target is the dense model’s output features for every image, whatever its source.
blocks.zh:
远景模型让我们能清晰地控制校正数据:我们可以以固定大小改变校正集的构成,并评价被压缩的网络的源头任务,并通过线性探测,在看不见的数据集上评价.
我们用这个来询问每种方法在压缩时间看评价分布的多少.
我们建造了两个大小相同的校正池:一个47k CIFAR-100训练图像的单一池,具有模型及其评价任务的内域,以及一个保存了10k并添加了Food-101的多样化池(Bossard等,2014年),CIFAR-10 (Krizhevsky,2009年),EuroSAT (Helber等,2018年),STL-10 (Coates等,2011年)和DTD (Cimpoi等,2014年),各封顶为10克图像.
所添加的数据集与CIFAR-100没有标签空间,因此表3只比较了无标签方法:无训练基线;PELA,其特性蒸馏不需要标签;LSP,其蒸馏目标为密集模型的输出特性,每个图像,无论来源如何.

Source : CIFAR-100 accuracy; Transfer : mean linear-probe accuracy on Pets, Aircraft and Places365, in neither pool; Gain : diverse minus single transfer, computed before rounding.

blocks.en:
Accuracy under calibration shift. Calibrated in-domain, the training-free baselines are close to LSP at 30%, but the gap opens with the ratio ( Table 3 ): at − 70 % -70\% LSP still scores 85.9 85.9 against the dense model’s 89.9 89.9 , where the strongest training-free baseline falls to 77.1 77.1 .
PELA, which retrains every weight, is the only baseline on par with LSP.
Moving the calibration data away from the evaluation distribution costs every method source accuracy, and LSP the least; since the two pools are matched in size, this isolates the composition of the calibration data from its amount.
blocks.zh:
校正分班下的精确度. 校准的域内无培训基线接近LSP,为30%,但差距随着比例(表3)而拉开:在--70%--70-=LSP仍然比稠密型号的89.9 89.9分,其中最强的无培训基线为77.1 77.1分。
PELA, 反射出每个重量, 是和LSP相同的唯一基线.
将校正数据从评价分布中移出,每一次方法源精度都要成本,最低点是LSP;由于两个集合的大小相匹配,这就将校正数据的构成与其量相隔离.

blocks.en:
Downstream transfer. Transfer is the mean frozen-feature linear-probe accuracy over Pets ( Parkhi et al., 2012 ) , Aircraft ( Maji et al., 2013 ) and Places365 ( Zhou et al., 2017 ) , none of them in any calibration pool, and Gain compares the two pools at matched size.
Calibration diversity helps the baselines little, while LSP has the largest gain at every ratio and the best transfer on the diverse pool at all three ratios, including − 50 % -50\% and − 70 % -70\% , where it trails on the single pool (per-target breakdown in Appendix G ).
Label-free training alone does not explain this: PELA trains on the same pools with the same budget, reaches the best single-pool transfer at − 50 -50 and − 70 % -70\% , but gains less from diversity than LSP at every ratio.
A label-free KL objective therefore not only gives most of the best results on both language and vision benchmarks, but also opens to a new axis for compression toward better zero-shot performance, exploiting unlabeled data to mimic the original abilities of the dense model.
blocks.zh:
下游转会. 转移是Pets上的平均冷冻地缘线性探测精度(Parkhi等人,2012年),飞机 (Maji等,2013年)和Places365(周等,2017年),均没有入出于任何校正池,盖因以相匹配的大小来比较这两个池.
校准多样性对基准作用不大,而LSP在每个比率上收益最大,而且在所有三个比率上,在不同的现金池上转让最多,包括-50%-50%-50%-70%-70%-70%-70%-70%-7%-7%-7%-7%-30%,在单一现金池上跟踪(附录G按目标分列)。
没有标签的培训本身并不能解释这一点: PELA列车在同一预算的同池列车中,以-50-50和-70%-70-%达到最佳的单池调车,但从多样性中获得的收益低于每个比例的LSP.
因此,无标签的KL目标不仅在语言和视觉基准上都给出了大部分最佳结果,而且还打开了压缩向更好的零发性能的新轴,利用无标签数据来模仿密集模型的原始能力.

blocks.en:
Decode throughput. At small batch sizes, decoding is memory-bound: each step reads every weight once.
At the same compression ratio, all factorizations read about the same number of weight bytes, so what separates them is how these bytes are split into matrix multiplies, since small multiplies achieve lower memory bandwidth than large ones.
LSP issues fewer of them: a tied group runs one shared input factor for Q/K/V where an untied factorization runs three, and a unit the allocator leaves dense ( Section 3.4 ) runs as one matrix multiply rather than two.
It is the fastest factorized model in all model–ratio settings we measure ( Appendix E ); on Llama-2-7B, it decodes faster than the dense model at every ratio ( 1.21 × 1.21\times , 1.36 × 1.36\times , and 1.56 × 1.56\times at − 30 -30 , − 50 -50 , and − 70 % -70\% ), whereas every untied factorization is slower than dense at − 30 % -30\% .
blocks.zh:
解码通量. 在小批量尺寸时,解码是内存绑定的:每一步读取每个重量一次.
在相同的压缩比下,所有因子化读取了大约相同的重量字节数,所以它们之间的区别在于这些字节是如何被分割成矩阵乘法的,因为小乘法比大乘法实现较低的内存带宽.
LSP发行量较少:一个捆绑的组为Q/K/V运行一个共享输入因子,其中不附带条件的成份分解为3个,而一个单位的分解器会以一个矩阵乘以2来运行密度(第3.4节).
它是我们测量的所有模型-梯度设置(附录E)中最快的因子化模型;在Llama-2-7B上,它在每个比分(1.21×1.21分时;1.36×1.36分时;1.56×1.56分时;-30-30分时;-50-50分时;-70-70分时)解码速度快于密度模型;而在-30%-30分时,每个不附带条件的因子化速度慢于密度.

blocks.en:
Latent-cache memory. Factorizing 𝑾 = 𝑩 ​ 𝑨 {\bm{W}}={\bm{B}}{\bm{A}} ( Equation 6 ) does not by itself shrink the KV cache, since 𝑩 {\bm{B}} restores the full width, but caching the latent 𝒛 = 𝑨 ​ 𝒙 {\bm{z}}={\bm{A}}{\bm{x}} does, given a dedicated attention implementation ( Section A.6 ).
As in MLA and Palu ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Chang et al., 2025 ) , the value factor absorbs into the output projection, while under rotary embeddings keys are rebuilt from the latent at each step, at a cost linear in context length and latent width that any latent factorization pays; the latent cache thus serves capacity rather than speed.
A tied group caches one latent where an untied factorization caches two, and the allocator compresses Q/K/V strongly ( Section 3.4 ), so LSP has the narrowest cache ( Table 5 ).
At − 70 % -70\% , with 128 128 k cached tokens and batch size 8 8 , weights plus cache take 13.5 × 13.5\times less memory than dense, against at most 6.5 × 6.5\times for untied factorizations.
A 95.5 GiB GPU thus holds about 320 320 k cached tokens per sequence, against at most 146 146 k: a memory capacity well beyond Llama-2-7B’s 4k training context.

blocks.en: 3.4 What Does LSP Compress?

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Pruning. Pruning removes weights scored by magnitude ( Han et al., 2015 ; Han et al., 2016 ) , by their movement during fine-tuning ( Sanh et al., 2020 ) , or by a local quadratic model of the loss ( LeCun et al., 1990 ; Hassibi et al., 1993 ) .
At LLM scale, the scores come from layer-wise reconstruction ( Frantar and Alistarh, 2023 ) , activation-scaled magnitudes ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , gradient-based group importance ( Ma et al., 2023 ) or layer redundancy ( Men et al., 2025 ) .
Recent methods learn what to remove against a global objective with the weights frozen, as semi-structured masks ( Fang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) or per-block widths ( Gao et al., 2024b ) , part of a broader shift from local to global criteria in structured pruning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
LSP brings this idea to low-rank compression: the removed set is a continuous subspace rather than a set of coordinates, so no discrete relaxation is needed, and the savings are realized as dense low-rank factors.
blocks.zh:
普润. Pruning通过微调时的运动(Sanh等,2020年),或用当地四分法模型计算损失(LeCun等,1990年;Hassibi等,1993年)。
在LLM尺度上,分数来自分层重建(Frantar and Alistarh, 2023年),活化尺度(Sun等, 2024年),梯度基组分(Ma等, 2023年)或分层冗余(Men等, 2025年).
近代方法学习了用被冰冻的重量去除全球目标,如半结构口罩(Fang等,2024;Liu等,2025;或每块宽度(Gao等,2024b)),这是从地方标准向全球标准在有结构地打磨中更广泛转变的一部分(Wang等,2026)。
LSP将这一想法带到了低等压缩:被移除的集是一个连续的子空间而不是一组坐标,因此不需要离散的放松,而节约作为密集的低等因素实现.

blocks.en:
Low-rank compression. Trained weights are not low-rank themselves, so most low-rank methods rely on the activations lying in lower-dimensional subspaces ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Garg et al., 2024 ) .
They choose the removed subspace per layer in closed form, either from activation statistics, as in ASVD ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , SliceGPT ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) , MoDeGPT ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , FLAR-SVD ( Thoma et al., 2025 ) and further variants ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Chiang et al., 2026 ) , or from the layer’s output reconstruction error, as in SVD-LLM ( Wang et al., 2025d ) and Swift-SVD ( Qi et al., 2026 ) .
Acting on one layer in isolation, these criteria do not see the network output, and their errors accumulate through depth ( Odema et al., 2026 ) .
Where the loss is used, it enters through a local surrogate, as in FW-SVD ( Hsu et al., 2022 ) and LLM-Surgeon ( van der Ouderaa et al., 2024 ) , or by fine-tuning the weights after truncation, as in SVD-LLM’s LoRA stage and PELA ( Guo et al., 2024 ) ; LSP instead optimizes the removed subspace itself against the network output, with the weights frozen.
blocks.zh:
低级压缩. 被训练的重量本身不是低等的,所以大多数低等的方法都依赖于被活化于下维子空间的活化(袁等,2024;Garg等,2024).
他们从激活统计中选择每层被清除的子空间,如ASVD(袁等,2024年),SlicGPT (Ashkboos等, 2024年), MODEGPT (Lin等,2025年),FLAR-SVD (Thoma等,2025年)和进一步变体 (Huang等,2025年;Li等,2025年;Chiang等,2026年),或出自地层出产重建错误,如SVD-LLLM (Wang等,2025d)和Swift-SVD (Qi等,2026年).
在孤立的一层上行动,这些标准看不到网络输出,它们的错误会从深度累积(Odema等,2026.).
在使用损失时,它通过一个本地代位进入,如FW-SVD(Hsu等,2022年)和LLM-外科(van der Ouderaa等,2024年),或者通过分流后微调权重,如SVD-LLM的LORA级和PELA(Guo等,2024年;LSP转而根据网络输出优化被移除的子空间本身,并冻结权重.

blocks.en:
Rank allocation and shared bases. Beyond choosing directions, compression also decides how the remaining capacity is laid out across the network.
Ranks are allocated non-uniformly across matrices from measured or estimated sensitivity ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Qi et al., 2026 ) or learned through a relaxation of the truncation position ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and factors are shared among matrices, across layers ( Wang et al., 2025a ) or among the Q/K/V projections that read the same activation ( Wang et al., 2025e ) .
The latter two adapt the structure of the compressed model to the network, but the basis at each rank remains closed-form.
LSP uses the same two levers: projectors are tied within each group of layers that share an input, and ranks are allocated per compression unit by applying whitened projections and measuring the change in output KL ( Section 2.2 ).
blocks.zh:
分级分配和共享基础。 除选择方向外,压缩还决定了整个网络如何布置剩余容量.
从测量或估计的敏感度(袁克等,2024;王克等,2025c;齐克等,2026)中分出不同矩阵的分级,或通过放松分级位置(王克等,2025b)学习,各种因素在矩阵之间,分层(王克等,2025a)或读取相同活化的Q/K/V预测(王克等,2025e)中共享.
后两者将压缩型号的结构与网络相适应,但每个等级的基础仍然是封闭式.
LSP使用相同的两个杠杆:投影仪被捆绑在每组共享输入的地层内,并通过应用被白化的预测并测量输出KL的变化来分配每个压缩单元的分级(第2.2节).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which compresses a pretrained network by learning, for each linear layer, the subspace the network can do without.
Its premise is that statistical redundancy, whether measured by activation energy or by layer-wise reconstruction error, is not functional redundancy.
LSP therefore selects the removed subspaces against the network output: it allocates ranks by measured output KL and optimizes all projectors jointly, with the pretrained weights frozen.
Across four decoder LLMs, one of its two objectives attains the lowest perplexity in all twelve model–ratio settings, and both achieve the best zero-shot accuracy among low-rank methods.
The margin grows with the compression ratio: at − 70 % -70\% on Llama-2-7B, LSP reaches 10.9 10.9 perplexity, against 13.3 13.3 for the strongest baseline and 222.8 222.8 without learning.
On a vision transformer, it is the most robust to calibration shift and transfers best when calibrated on diverse unlabeled data.
The merged model is also the fastest factorization we measure, decoding up to 1.56 × 1.56\times faster than the dense model.
Its shared latent reduces the memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5 × 13.5\times at a 128k-token context, twice the savings of untied factorizations.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了可学习的子空间预测(LSP),它通过学习每个线性层来压缩一个预先训练的网络,对于网络可以没有的子空间.
它的前提是,统计冗余,无论是以活化能衡量还是以分层重建错误衡量,都不是功能冗余.
因此,LSP根据网络输出选择被移除的子空间:它通过所测量的输出KL来分配排行,并联合优化所有投影仪,同时将预受训练的重量冻结.
在四个解码器LLMs中,它的两个目标之一在所有12个模型-ratio设置中都实现了最小的迷惑性,两者都实现了低等方法中最佳的零射入精度.
该比值随压缩比而增加:Llama-2-7B的比值为-70%-70%-70%;LSP为10.9 10.9;而最强基线的比值为13.3 13.3;不学习的为222.8 22.2.8。
在视向变压器上,它是最能校正相变和在各种无标签数据上校正时最能转动的.
被合并的模型也是我们测得最快的入计量,解码可达1.56×1.56\时速快于密集模型.
其共享的潜想在128k-token上将重量和KV缓存的内存减少13.5×13.5\tims,比不附带条件的因子化节省了两倍.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: By substantially lowering the parameter and compute footprint of large models, LSP contributes to the democratization of pretrained transformers, making strong language and vision models deployable on edge devices and in domain-specialized applications where retraining from scratch is infeasible. As with any compression method, the compressed model is a lossy approximation of the original; while our experiments show small aggregate degradation, this loss may be unevenly distributed across subpopulations, domains, or rare-event behaviors that the calibration distribution under-represents. We recommend that downstream practitioners evaluate compressed models on the same fairness, robustness, and safety metrics they would apply to the dense baseline before deploying them.
blocks.zh: 通过大幅降低参数并计算出大型模型的足迹,LSP促进了被预先训练的变压器的民主化,使强大的语言和视觉模型可以被部署在边缘装置上,以及从零开始再培训不可行的域专门应用中. 与任何压缩方法一样,被压缩的模型是原始模型的亏损近似;虽然我们的实验显示的聚合降解度很小,但这种损失可能分布在亚人群,域中,或者罕见的事件行为中,校正分布不足. 我们建议下游从业者评估压缩模型的公平性、稳健性和安全度量度,在部署这些模型之前,应适用于密集基线。

A.7 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.7 限制

blocks.en:
(i) The measured-KL allocation is a local surrogate: isolated unit costs omit interactions, and the current strategy has no global-optimality guarantee. This makes the allocation uncertain on quality in specific settings:
in a few cases uniform ranks can still be preferred; however empirical evidence shows that measured KL is still better, since it is able to adapt to different architectures: performance improvement over Qwen3-4B, OPT-1.3B, and two out of three compression ranges of Llama-2-7B.
(ii) Compression is also not free: LSP requires both the KL measurements and projection training, although the measurements are reusable across ratios and objectives. On the other hand, compression is a one-off cost that is repaid by the inference savings of Section 3.3 and LSP justifies this with the strong performance.
(iii) Tied groups only lead to savings with latent cache if KV are tied on the input side. This means our best configuration for Qwen3-4B does not gain in efficiency as much as the input-tied version does. This represents a performance-efficiency trade-off, as shown in Table 12 : tying KV on the output side leads to the best performance, but one can choose to tie KV on the input side for improved inference efficiency instead.
blocks.zh:
(一) 量度-KL分配是本地代位:孤立的单位成本省略了相互作用,而目前的策略没有全球-最优的保证. 这使得分配在特定环境下的质量不确定:
在少数情况下,仍然可以选择统一的排名;然而,经验证据表明,测量到的KL仍然更好,因为它能够适应不同的架构:比Qune3-4B, OPP-1.3B的性能改进,以及Llama-2-7B的3个压缩范围中的2个.
(二)压缩也不是免费的:LSP需要KL测量和投影训练,虽然测量可以跨比率和目标重复使用. 另一方面,压缩是一种一次性费用,通过第3.3节的推论节省来偿还,而LSP则以强劲的性能证明这一点是合理的。
(三) 如果 KV 绑定在输入侧面, 绑定的组只会通过潜在的缓存来节省费用。 这意味着我们Qwen3-4B的最佳配置没有像输入端版那样提高效率. 这代表了性能效率的权衡,如表12所示:将KV捆绑在输出方会导致最佳性能,但人们可以选择将KV捆绑在输入方来提高推论效率.

blocks.en: Compression ratio. A ratio is the fraction of the parameters of the compressible linear layers that is removed — the layers LSP substitutes, excluding embeddings, the language-model head and the normalizations — counted on the merged model with shared factors counted once. This is the denominator SVD-LLM, Swift-SVD and Dobi-SVD also report against, so nominal ratios are directly comparable. The measured-KL allocator greedily fills the budget and integer-trims its last move, and realized savings land within 0.25 0.25 points of nominal in every cell ( − 30.0 -30.0 – 30.2 30.2 , − 50.0 -50.0 – 50.2 50.2 and − 70.0 -70.0 – 70.2 % 70.2\% ).
blocks.zh: 压缩比。 一个比率是被去除的可压缩线性地层参数的分数——层LSP替代品,不包括嵌入,语言模型头和常态——算入合并模型,共享因素计算一次. 这是分母SVD-LLM,Swift-SVD和多比-SVD也对照报告,所以名义比率是直接可比较的. 计量-KL分配器贪得无厌地填补了预算,整数-特里姆最后一次行动,实现的储蓄在0.250.25分以内,每个单元格(-30.0.0-30.0-30.2;-50.0.0-50.2;-70.0.0-70.2-70.2)。

blocks.en:
Baselines. All baselines are using the same calibration budget of 1024 1024 sequences of 2048 2048 tokens, run with bf16 weights and compression arithmetic in fp32 or fp64 (following LSP), and, for the SVD methods, are evaluated in factorized form. Where a baseline exposes a tuning knob we sweep it around the published value and keep the best per model and ratio: SVD-LLM’s recovery learning rate against its single published one, Dobi-SVD’s γ \gamma learning rate around the released default, Swift-SVD’s allocation α \alpha over its own eleven-point grid, and ASVD’s α \alpha . Dobi-SVD is run without its quantization step so that parameter counts match; Swift-SVD’s OPT rows are bias-corrected; SVD-LLM’s recovery stage is LoRA of rank 8 8 on the calibration corpus of the table it appears in.
Notice that LSP keeps original weights frozen, and learns to compress their subspace, which means it does not move from the original subspace but only projects.
SVD-LLM-v2 ( Wang et al., 2025c ) and MoDeGPT ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , though relevant, could not be reported as no official implementation has been released. The ViT ports of SVD-LLM (W) and SliceGPT are adapted from the official released implementation, while FLAR-SVD and PELA come from their official implementation. PELA, specifically, re-trains all the network’s weights with the objective to copy the dense model’s intermediate features, which acts as a recovery fine-tuning stage.
blocks.zh:
基线。 所有基线都使用相同的1024 1024个序列2048个令牌的校正预算,在fp32或fp64(跟随LSP)中以bf16重量和压缩算法运行,对于SVD方法,则以成因法评价. 当一个基线暴露出一个调子时,我们绕过已公布的数值并保持每个模型和比率的最佳:SVD-LLM的恢复学习率与其单一公布的数值相比,Dobi-SVD的γ\gamma的学习率围绕已公布的默认值,Swift-SVD的α\α分配值覆盖了其自身的11分网格,ASVD的α\α. Dobi-SVD 运行时没有量化步骤, 参数计算一致 ; Swift-SVD 的 Coption 排行是偏差校正 ; SVD-LLM 的恢复阶段是 LORA 排名 8 。
注意LSP保留了原有的权重被冷冻,并学会压缩他们的子空间,这意味着它不会从原来的子空间移出,而只是工程.
SVD-LLM-v2(Wang等,2025c)和MODEGPT(Lin等,2025)虽然相关,但因未发布正式执行而无法报告. SVD-LLM (W)和SlicetGPT的ViT端口由官方发布的执行改编而来,而FLAR-SVD和PELA则由它们的官方执行而来. PELA,具体地说,重新显示网络的所有重量,目的是复制稠密的模型的中间特征,它起到回收微调阶段的作用.

blocks.en: Evaluation. Perplexity follows the SparseGPT and SliceGPT convention: the test split is joined, tokenized once and cut into non-overlapping 2048 2048 -token windows. Zero-shot accuracy is measured with the EleutherAI harness ( Gao et al., 2024a ) at zero shots on the merged model, and we report plain accuracy.
blocks.zh: 评价。 迷惑性遵循了SparseGPT和SlicGPT的常规:测试分拆被加入,一次发号施令并切入非重叠的2048 2048 - token窗口. 零发精度用EleutherAI(Gao等,2024a.)在合并模型上以零发精度来测量,我们报告纯发精度.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. The choice of benchmarks follows other compression methods in the literature. In Table 1 we report perplexity for a diverse mix of pruning and low-rank compression methods, as reported by Ashkboos et al. (2024) ; van der Ouderaa et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025d) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Qi et al. (2026) . For zero-shot performance ( Table 2 ) we restrict the analysis to low-rank compression methods ( Wang et al., 2025d ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Qi et al., 2026 ) , since they are the closest to LSP. Specifically, we report the same six benchmark evaluations as baselines do, and calibrate on the same datasets. While Alpaca-calibrated compression follows our compression ratios reported for other tables, for C4-calibrated compression we follow same procedure as Swift-SVD, with compression ratios of − 20 % / 40 % / 60 % -20\%/40\%/60\% , to introduce further richness in compression ratios. We re-evaluate all methods and benchmarks for evaluation fairness, using the same setup for calibration and evaluation for all methods.

Table 12 crosses the two allocations with forced Q/K/V input tying and with the grouped-query routing (K and V share an output-side factor, Q is projected alone), at fixed objective, learning rate, epoch budget and realized savings. blocks.en: Where the budget goes. On OPT-125M, Q/K/V blocks are the least compressed at all compression budgets, especially the last layers, which stay uncompressed at all compression ratios. For both OPT models, the last layers tend to be less compressed than earlier layers. For Qwen3-4B, an interesting behavior appears: because of non-tying Q and K/V together, Q becomes the most compressed layer at all compression ratios, while K/V layers are almost never compressed (only for few early layer, at − 70 % -70\% compression). In addition, MLP layers are also compressed less, especially the down-projection one. The ViT instead shows a pattern where middle layers get compressed less, at all compression ratios.

Removal looks as in Llama’s average: it spreads over the whole spectrum rather than the tail a weight SVD would cut, deepens with the ratio, and reaches the first singular direction, most strongly in the up projection on OPT-1.3B (direction 1 1 loses 2.5 2.5 – 4.4 4.4 of its amplitude in block 3 3 ) and in the tied Q/K/V on Llama-2-7B ( 0.7 0.7 – 2.3 2.3 ).

blocks.en: K/V routing at deployment. Table 15 gives the deployment cost of the four Qwen3-4B arms of Table 12 . Within a ratio they hold the same weights ( 6.14 6.14 , 4.78 4.78 and 3.43 3.43 GiB) and issue the same decode FLOPs ( 7.80 7.80 , 6.35 6.35 and 4.89 4.89 GFLOP per step). The allocation sets the speed: the measured budget is faster than the uniform one in all six pairs ( 22 22 , 10 10 and 8 % 8\% at − 20 % -20\% , − 40 % -40\% and − 60 % -60\% ) because it leaves units dense, whereas the uniform rule factorizes every layer and decodes slower than the dense model at − 20 -20 and − 40 % -40\% . Input tying is 2 2 – 4 % 4\% faster than the output-side routing in all six pairs, since one shared input factor serves Q, K and V in a single matrix multiply. The routing mainly decides the cache, in a direction set by the allocation: it narrows the uniform cache by about 8 % 8\% and widens the measured one to or near the dense width. No configuration wins on all three axes: uniform with output-side K/V holds the longest context but is the slowest, measured with input tying is the fastest, and measured with output-side K/V is the most accurate but caches nearly as much as the dense model.

blocks.en: Measured-KL allocation with K/V tied on the output side is the most accurate configuration at every ratio ( Table 12 ), so we use it as the default. When deployment efficiency matters more, LSP supports the other trade-offs: uniform allocation with output-side K/V holds the longest context, and measured allocation with input-side tying decodes fastest.

Figure 6 compares LSP’s compression cost with that of activation-based methods (SliceGPT, Swift-SVD) and loss-aware ones (LLM-Surgeon, Dobi-SVD, SVD-LLM), on OPT-125M, Qwen3-4B and Llama-2-7B.
Giving the loss-aware baselines more budget does not close the gap. LLM-Surgeon calibrated on LSP’s 1024 1024 sequences costs 4 4 – 6 × 6\times more than at its default 128 128 , and its perplexity does not improve. Dobi-SVD, trained for 20 20 epochs on the same 1024 1024 samples, costs 2 2 – 103 103 wall-clock hours and stays far behind: 61.2 61.2 against 10.9 10.9 perplexity on Llama-2-7B at − 70 % -70\% .
blocks.zh:
图6 LSP的压缩成本与基于激活的方法(SliceGPT, Swift-SVD)和有损失意识的方法(LLM-外科医生,多比-SVD,SVD-LLM)在OPL-125M,Qune3-4B和Llama-2-7B上的压缩成本.
增加意识到损失的基线预算并不能弥补差距。 LLM-外科医生在LSP的1024 1024序列上校正了4 – 6 × 6 相较于默认时多出128 128次,其复杂度没有改善. Dobi-SVD在同一个1024 1024个样本上为20个世纪培训,花费了2 2 – 103 103个墙上小时,并远远落后于:61.2 61.2 – 10.9 10.9 Llama-2-7B上的迷惑度为--70%--70\%.

blocks.en:
Compression cost is paid once per model and ratio, and it is small next to the cost of serving the compressed model. We argue it should therefore not drive the choice between methods, whereas accuracy and inference efficiency ( Section 3.3 ) are paid on every query.
Even so, LSP is Pareto-optimal at higher budgets: at every model–ratio setting, one of its two objectives gives the lowest perplexity, within 0.5 0.5 – 10 10 wall-clock hours. Only methods that are cheaper and less accurate share the frontier: SVD-LLM with LoRA recovery, SliceGPT and Swift-SVD.
LSP T converges faster than LSP, reaching its validation optimum at up to 2.5 × 2.5\times lower cost ( 4.1 4.1 against 10.1 10.1 hours on Llama-2-7B at − 50 % -50\% ), though at a higher perplexity at − 50 -50 and − 70 % -70\% .
The KL measurement is a substantial fixed cost: 0.17 0.17 , 1.74 1.74 and 1.11 1.11 wall-clock hours on OPT-125M, Qwen3-4B and Llama-2-7B. The LSP points use individual-run perplexities, which can differ from the three-seed means of Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
压缩成本每个模型和比例支付一次,它与服务压缩模型的成本相邻也很小. 因此,我们认为它不应推动在方法之间作出选择,而准确性和推断效率(第3.3节)则在每一次查询中支付。
即便如此,LSP在更高的预算水平上也是最理想的:在每一个模型-ratio设置中,它的两个目标之一都给出了最小的迷惑性,在0.5 — 10个时钟之内。 只有比较便宜和不太准确的方法可以共享边疆:SVD-LLM与LORA回收,SlicetGPT和Swift-SVD.
LSP 软件 T会比LSP更快地汇合,在最高为2.5×2.5\x的低成本时达到最佳的验证(在Llama-2-7B上,4.1–10.1小时为-50%-50\%),尽管在-50-50和-70%-70\%时达到更高的复杂度.
KL测量是相当高的固定成本:在PALP-125M、Qune3-4B和Llama-2-7B上,0.17 0.17、1.74 1.74和1.11 1.11墙小时。 LSP点使用个人运行的迷惑,这与表1的"三种子"方式不同.

blocks.en:
Table 16 breaks down the ViT transfer results of Table 3 by calibration pool and target.
The pools grow from CIFAR-100 alone ( 10 10 k images) to the six-dataset pool of Table 3 ( 47 47 k), with the same images for every method. LSP’s mean transfer rises with every added dataset at every ratio, and on the full pool it is best on all three targets at every ratio; the baselines gain less and not always monotonically (FLAR-SVD at − 50 % -50\% loses 4.4 4.4 points when CIFAR-10 and EuroSAT are added).
The last row of each method is CIFAR-100 alone at the size of the full pool. For LSP, this extra CIFAR-100 data changes mean transfer by + 1.2 +1.2 , − 0.6 -0.6 and + 0.8 +0.8 points at − 30 / 50 / 70 % -30/50/70\% , whereas the diverse pool exceeds this size-matched control by 3.7 3.7 , 7.1 7.1 and 6.6 6.6 points (the Gain of Table 3 ): the gain comes from pool composition, not size.
